# Create test skill extension configuration

**Type:** task (implementation) · **Priority:** high · **Stage:** intake_complete

## Goal

Create `.pi/skills_extensions/test/extension.json` that defines the `types` map binding TCE's staged and granular test profiles to `/skill:test --type`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The file exists and parses as a JSON object with a `types` map.
- The `types` map defines: `unit`, `smoke`, `dev`, `browser`, `tutorial`, `e2e`, `electron` (each a non-empty command string or list).
- The `full` key is deliberately omitted (falls back to the real CI suite).
- Browser-dependent types (`smoke`, `dev`, `browser`, `tutorial`, `e2e`) chain `check-browser-test-env.ts` before Vitest.
- Every typed Vitest command runs through `vitest-run-with-retry.ts` with the TAP reporter flags.
- `tutorial` runs each tutorial part in its own command in the established order (part3 last).
- `e2e` includes all tutorial parts plus the `replay-e2e` project.
- `electron` maps to the extracted display-aware runner script.

## Dependencies
- No dependencies; this is the foundational configuration.

# Reputation-cost discard engine

## Goal

Make `discardFromHand` charge the card's coin cost in reputation (clamped at 0) so discarding is a meaningful decision rather than free. This is the tracer-bullet vertical slice for parent AC2 (code + tests + doc comments).

## Acceptance Criteria

- `discardFromHand` deducts `card.cost` from `state.resourceBank.reputation` for business, community-space, upgrade and event cards.
- Reputation is clamped at 0 (`Math.max(0, reputation - cost)`); the discard is never blocked on affordability; 0-cost cards deduct nothing.
- Unit tests in `tests/main-street/discard-from-hand.test.ts` cover rep deduction, clamp at 0, each family, a 0-cost card, and an unaffordable-but-allowed discard.
- The `discardFromHand` doc comment (`MainStreetMarketHand.ts`) and the `DiscardFromHandAction` doc comment (`MainStreetEngineTypes.ts`) no longer say "for free" and state the reputation cost.
- `state.actionsRemaining` is unchanged by a discard (existing behaviour preserved and asserted).

- Parent AC traceability — **Reputation penalty:** `discardFromHand` deducts `card.cost` from `state.resourceBank.reputation`, **clamped at 0** (reputation is never negative). The penalty applies to **every family** (business, community-space, upgrade, event) and uses each card's listed coin `cost`; 0-cost cards cost nothing. The discard is **not** gated on affordability (a low-reputation player may still discard, down to 0).

## Minimal Implementation

- In `discardFromHand`, after routing the card to its family discard pile, apply `state.resourceBank.reputation = Math.max(0, state.resourceBank.reputation - card.cost)`.
- Include the reputation cost in the activity-log message (e.g. `(cost N rep)`).
- Update the "for free" doc comments.
- Write the new unit tests first (TDD), then implement.

## Deliverables

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarketHand.ts` (behaviour + comment)
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineTypes.ts` (comment)
- `tests/main-street/discard-from-hand.test.ts` (new)
- Updates to `tests/main-street/action-economy.test.ts`

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarketHand.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineTypes.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineActions.ts`
- `tests/main-street/discard-from-hand.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/action-economy.test.ts`

# Undo/redo restores discard pile

## Goal

Fix the command snapshot so undoing a discard restores the family discard pile alongside the hand and reputation. Planning found that `state.discards` is NOT captured by `captureSnapshot` in `MainStreetCommands.ts`, so undo currently leaves the discarded card both in the hand and in the discard pile (and redo re-adds it again). This is required by parent AC3.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `MarketActionSnapshot`, `captureSnapshot` and `restoreSnapshot` in `MainStreetCommands.ts` capture and restore every `state.discards` family (business, communitySpace, upgrade, event, staff).
- Undo of `discardFromHandCommand` restores the hand, the matching family discard pile, and the reputation deducted.
- Redo re-applies all three exactly once — the card is never duplicated across hand and discard.
- Unit tests assert a full undo/redo round-trip for a business card and at least one non-business family.

- Parent AC traceability — **Action-free and reversible:** Discarding consumes **no daily action** (`state.actionsRemaining` is unchanged), preserving the current action economy. Undo/redo via `discardFromHandCommand` restores the hand, the family discard pile, and the reputation deducted.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add `discards: any | null` to `MarketActionSnapshot`; capture via `safeClone(state.discards)`; restore in `restoreSnapshot`.
- Add undo/redo round-trip tests (write first).

## Dependencies

- Depends on `CG-0MUEQ12ED0042425` (Reputation-cost discard engine) — the reputation deduction must exist to assert against.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCommands.ts`
- `tests/main-street/command-action-economy.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/discard-from-hand.test.ts`

# Discard button and handler

## Goal

Give the player a working discard control: a **[Discard]** button in the End Turn slot once a hand card is selected, wired to an undoable handler with animation + SFX. Covers parent AC1 and the action-free/undo parts of AC3.

## Acceptance Criteria

- During `placing-from-hand`, `refreshActionButtons` renders **[Discard]** in the rightmost action-bar slot (where [Cancel] sits today) with [Cancel] shifted left; the label states the reputation cost (e.g. `Discard (-3 rep)`).
- The button is created with `createActionButton` and positioned from existing SLL layout values (no hardcoded pixel coordinates).
- Clicking [Discard] executes `discardFromHandCommand` through the undo manager, plays the discard animation and `SFX_KEYS.DISCARD` (reduced-motion respected), logs the action, clears `pendingHandIndex`, returns `uiPhase` to `market`, and refreshes the HUD.
- Tutorial gating is respected (`isTutorialActionAllowed`); a disallowed discard shows illegal-move feedback and does not mutate state.
- A browser test asserts the button appears when a hand card is selected, discards it, deducts reputation, and returns to the market phase.
- Undo after a UI discard restores the hand, discard pile and reputation.

- Parent AC traceability — **UI affordance and trigger:** Once a hand card is selected, a **[Discard]** button is rendered in the action bar's rightmost slot — the position occupied by **[End Turn]** in the market phase (the same slot `placing-from-hand` currently gives **[Cancel]**). Clicking it discards the selected hand card and returns the UI to the market phase; **[Cancel]** remains available alongside it (shifted left). No confirmation dialog is shown (producer decision). The button is created via `createActionButton`, positioned via the existing SLL layout values, and labelled with the reputation cost it will deduct.
- Parent AC traceability — **Action-free and reversible:** Discarding consumes **no daily action** (`state.actionsRemaining` is unchanged), preserving the current action economy. Undo/redo via `discardFromHandCommand` restores the hand, the family discard pile, and the reputation deducted.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add `onDiscardHandCard` in `MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts`; delegate from `MainStreetTurnController.ts` and `MainStreetScene.ts`.
- Render the [Discard] button in `MainStreetRendererHud.ts` for the `placing-from-hand` branch, shifting [Cancel] left.
- Reuse/extend the animator for discard feedback (animation + SFX).
- Add the browser test (write first).

## Dependencies

- Depends on `CG-0MUEQ12ED0042425` (engine) and the undo-snapshot fix.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimator.ts`
- `tests/main-street/discard-from-hand.browser.test.ts` (new)

# Event-card select-then-act flow

## Goal

Make held event cards discardable by the player. Event cards currently auto-play on click, so they have no selectable state. Introduce a select-then-act flow (click selects; **[Play]** and **[Discard]** both offered) without regressing the one-click play path. Risk-driven decision point.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Clicking a held event card enters a selectable state and highlights it; the action bar offers **[Play]** and **[Discard]**.
- **[Play]** preserves today's `play-event` behaviour and action economy.
- The tutorial "Triggering Events" step (T23, `requiredAction: 'play-event'`) and its E2E parts pass unchanged; `tutorial-action-economy` tests pass.
- Go/no-go: if the selection change cannot preserve T23, the event UI is deferred to a follow-up work item and the existing one-click play path is left untouched — the decision and rationale are recorded on this item. The engine penalty (F1) still covers event cards either way.

## Minimal Implementation

- Change the event hand-card click in `MainStreetRendererStreet.ts` to select (enter a selectable phase) instead of calling `onPlayHeldEvent` directly.
- Add a **[Play]** button to the selectable phase in `MainStreetRendererHud.ts` that calls the existing `onPlayHeldEvent`.
- Guard the tutorial gate, verify T23, and revert + file the follow-up if it regresses.

## Dependencies

- Depends on the Discard button and handler item.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererStreet.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/TutorialFlow.ts`
- `tests/e2e/main-street-tutorial-e2e-part*.browser.test.ts`

# AI weighs reputation cost

## Goal

Stop the AI treating discard as free: weigh the reputation cost in discard enumeration/evaluation, and re-baseline Monte Carlo bands only where the change moves them. Covers parent AC4.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AI discard enumeration/evaluation accounts for the reputation cost (prefers lower-cost cards; discards only when the capacity benefit outweighs the reputation loss).
- Deterministic seeded tests assert the AI's discard decisions reflect the reputation cost.
- `npm run monte-carlo` is run; every design-intent band that moves is re-baselined with a written justification (bands are never silently widened).
- Monte Carlo results and any re-baseline decision are recorded on this item.

## Minimal Implementation

- Update the discard enumeration sites and the action-evaluation case in `MainStreetAiStrategy.ts`.
- Add deterministic tests.
- Run the Monte Carlo harness and compare against documented baselines.

## Dependencies

- Depends on `CG-0MUEQ12ED0042425` (engine).

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts`
- `tests/main-street/` (AI strategy tests)
- Monte Carlo baselines under `docs/main-street/`

# Documentation sweep for discard cost

## Goal

Update every player-facing and developer-facing description of hand discard so none still claims it is free. Covers parent AC5.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` moves "Discarding from hand" out of the free-operations list and documents the reputation cost and clamp.
- `example-games/main-street/README.md` states the reputation cost.
- `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` no longer advertises discard as free; `MainStreetHint.ts` mentions the cost.
- A grep for stale "free" discard references across source and docs returns none.
- Any relevant wiki/docs-site entry is updated or a follow-up work item is created.

## Acceptance Criteria
